description: The truth of the Plague Village reveals the dialectical relationship between immortality and amnesia: living too long inevitably leads to forgetting; does the person who forgets cease to exist?

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 knelt on the ground, hugging Dolores's leg, and said, "Please, transfer their pain to me. Don't you want everyone to be together? I will stay with you forever..." Dolores turned her head away; faced with such a request, she didn't want to agree but couldn't refuse either. So she cast the spell. On that day, the villagers found their illnesses miraculously gone, while the hero party silently left the town. player5 let out a scream the moment the disease was transferred and then fainted. Hidariva volunteered to carry him, while the others silently lowered their heads, not daring to look at his current state.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 felt heavy-hearted. On the way back to the Royal City, she occasionally tried to stroke player5's palm, hoping to bring a moment of peace and warmth.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Um, since player5 is already injured like this, why don't we rest here for the night..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: player2 couldn't bear to watch anymore. I don't want the people I love to become like this! Why... why did it still turn out this way even though everyone's wishes were fulfilled...

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...Yeah. Let's set up camp as usual." player3 pulled out the camping tools from player5's backpack and started setting up camp. Without a conscious Lucien, what used to be a simple task now became extremely difficult.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 was annoyed by this. player4 was carrying someone and felt tired. And with no fights, it was boring. "Why the hell is it so chaotic..." player4 scratched their head, utterly frustrated. player4 hated melodrama and only liked fighting! Whatever, everyone wants to live, right? And no one wants Lucien dead, right? player4 wanted to sleep, but clearly, no one could sleep now. "Maybe turning into a demon would give me a chance to sleep." player4 muttered, running off to find player3.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...player2, could you start a fire?" Seeing her pale face, player3 wanted to distract her a little.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 looked at player5's ashen, pained sleeping face and quietly covered him with a blanket. Since player5 had already endured so much for the villagers... why should player5 suffer so much for villagers he's never met... Thinking this, she gently woke player5.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Um... little player8..." player2 also quietly approached player8 and player5.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player3 hesitated. But player4 said they wanted to sleep, and everyone didn't want Lucien to suffer, so this would kill multiple birds with one stone! player4 needed sleep, Lucien needed to come back to life, the villagers needed to be happy. A great thing, right? And if anyone wanted to die, player4 could help them die too. So player3 transferred the pain from the villagers on player5 to player4.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Even a gentle touch was unbearable for player5 at this moment. "Landriel...?" he asked softly, his face contorted in pain. "Is there... something you need..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "You have a way, right... I know you have unique powers. Little Dolores is the Demon King's daughter, but you just looked at her and gave her a suggestion, right?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: But it failed, as expected. Only the pain transfer succeeded; player4 did not become a demon. player5 vomited three jin of blood but survived. player4 became a person in immense pain. The villagers' pain was transferred to player4, but the attempt to become a demon, which defied who knows what, inevitably had backlash. The villagers' pain was doubled and returned, and the pain on player4 would persist for a long time. player4 messed everything up. But for her, this might not be a bad thing.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player4 extrapower perpetual motion machine 2 fun-seeker 2 2 (Damn, the God of Pain doesn't care about balance, the God of Pain is an SM god)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 sensed the change happening to him. He got up and saw Hidariva seemed to be in great pain, quickly crawling to her side. "Hidariva, what's wrong? What did you do? How did this happen?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 saw a companion fall before her once again. Little Hidariva fell into "sleep," but expressions of pain and joy appeared on her face. player3 felt endless sorrow.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Pain—if not player5 suffering, then player4 suffering. They're just villagers we've never met; why should we bear so much for them?! player8 thought painfully, the people I love shouldn't endure so much pain...

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: @player5 representing justice to eliminate you +4 1 player6 "She wanted to sleep." player3 tightly hugged player4. She didn't know why; as the last demon who manually manipulated life and death transformation, facing such a scene, player3 could only watch.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 felt they were okay, just said sorry. Could finally get a good sleep. But can't tell Lucien; he'd get angry. Sorry, villagers, but I really don't want to die. I'll forget all this and sneak out to forge later, just pretend the villagers never existed... player4 fell into sleep.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: As long as there is eternal pain, it can be exchanged for normal life and death, right? Human lifespans are short, but humans can reproduce, so pain must be able to be passed down eternally...

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Then he looked at the other companions and gradually realized what might have happened. "The pain... was transferred again, right?" He knelt beside Hidariva. "Why did you do this? I could have endured it..."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Anyway, let's activate mind control and Love-obsessed heavy girl first!

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The companion in my arms is suffering, people outside the window are dying of illness, and the kingdom is raining today." player3 only focused on sorrowfully saying useless things; she had already despaired of the current situation. As long as the life-death transformation and "everything has a price" cannot be changed, then the current situation is unsolvable.
